lookup_atomic_radius: look up the atomic radius in picometers for a given element by its atomic number from the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary
import_atomic_radii: import the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary from fairchem.core.datasets.embeddings.atomic_radii for use in embedding calculations
check_nan_radius: check if an element has an unavailable atomic radius by testing for NaN in the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary
iterate_atomic_radii: iterate over the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary to find elements within a specific radius range
reference_atomic_radii: reference the ATOMIC_RADII constant as a lookup table mapping atomic numbers 0-100 to their radii in picometers
